note: SCRAPED, NOT SYNTHETIC. Real payer policy text retrieved via Bright Data (zone tally_fda) and cached at author time; nothing fetches at runtime. Verbatim cell text only - no summarisation, no paraphrase, no spelling corrections. This file is SEPARATE from data/policies.json on purpose: policies.json drives the live demo and is validated by npm run verify, and a scraped document must not be able to break a working clinical path. Absence of a clause here is not evidence a payer lacks one.
